title: Diff-based reconciliation of conflicting edits
description: Raised in grilling (HANDOVER §4). When a write is stale (409 / exit 2), reconcile field-wise (and per thread entry) against the base revision instead of only rejecting, surfacing true conflicts to the human. Ties into visual edit locks. Not designed yet.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Non-overlapping concurrent edits merge automatically in CLI and UI
Overlapping edits surface a clear conflict; tests

thread.author: claude
thread.body: What is the merge unit: whole fields only (title, description, labels as whole arrays), or text-level merging inside description/notes and per-element merging of labels, criteria and thread entries?

thread.author: claude
thread.body: When two edits touch the same field, who decides in the UI: block and show both versions (as today), or offer a per-field pick/merge? And for the CLI: fail with exit 2, or auto-merge when non-overlapping?
